title.zh: 瑞士FINMA批准该国首只面向零售投资者的现货比特币ETF
title.en: FINMA approves Switzerland's first spot Bitcoin ETF for retail investors

current_state.zh: FINMA approved Switzerland’s first Bitcoin ETF that invests directly in BTC and is available to retail investors, with multiple fund providers having submitted applications.
current_state.en: FINMA approved Switzerland’s first Bitcoin ETF that invests directly in BTC and is available to retail investors, with multiple fund providers having submitted applications.

updates.what_changed_zh: Switzerland's FINMA approved the country's first spot Bitcoin ETF for retail investors, using a regulated investment-fund structure with stricter custody, operational-risk and disclosure requirements instead of the debt-security format used by existing Swiss Bitcoin ETPs.
